mapper.sql: id, app_name, package_name, version, build_number, features, is_beta, path, create_time, download_times, size, deleted, show_update_popup, force_update
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_info (app_name, package_name, version, build_number, features, is_beta, path, create_time, download_times, size, deleted, show_update_popup, force_update) VALUES (#{appName}, #{packageName}, #{version}, #{buildNumber}, #{features}, #{isBeta}, #{path}, #{createTime}, #{downloadTimes}, #{size}, #{deleted}, #{showUpdatePopup}, #{forceUpdate})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_info WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM app_info WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM app_info WHERE package_name = #{packageName} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM app_info WHERE package_name = #{packageName} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE app_info SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_info SET download_times = download_times + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
